name: 1911 Grip Scope Mount
description: A versatile accessory designed for the Government Model 1911 pistol. This black grip mount allows for the easy attachment of a scope, improving target acquisition and accuracy.

name: 1911 Sight Mount Trijicon
description: The Trijicon RMRcc Pistol Dovetail Mount is a steel mounting solution designed for Kimber 1911 and Ultra Carry pistols. It is intended to replace the rear sight and securely attach the Trijicon RMRcc red dot sight.

name: 1911 Sight Mount Vortex
description: The Sight Mount for 1911 with Adjustable Sights facilitates the installation of red-dot optics without requiring permanent firearm modifications. This mount replaces the rear sight, providing a stable base for the optic while retaining the option to revert to the original sight setup.

name: ACOG Mount
description: An intermediate piece used for mounting ACOG sights to Picatinny rails.

name: AEMS High Mount
description: A raised optic mount for the Holosun AEMS. Its increased sight height allows for a more upright head position while providing additional clearance for other rail-mounted accessories.

name: AEMS Low Mount
description: A low-profile optic mount for the Holosun AEMS. It positions the optic close to the weapon's top rail, providing a compact sighting setup with a lower sight line.

name: Aimpoint Acro Picatinny Mount
description: The Aimpoint Acro Mount is a precision-machined, durable mount for securely attaching Acro Series red dot sights to Weaver or Picatinny rails. It offers a stable, low-profile installation with quick and easy attachment, making it ideal for tactical and sport shooting.

name: AK Rear Sight Rail
description: An aluminum rear sight rail manufactured by Strike Industries for AK-pattern rifles. It replaces the original rear sight with a Picatinny rail for mounting low-profile optics while retaining a backup aiming channel for use with the front sight.

name: AK-303M Mount
description: The AK-303 side mount has a rail that extends above the receiver, allowing for the installation of optical devices.

name: AK/AKM BP-02 Side Mount
description: The BP-02 side mount is a quick-release mount with a weaver rail, and its lower part is compatible with AK and Saiga types. This rugged construction is made of aluminum alloy.

name: Alien Ironsight Toprail
description: The Alien slide is a compact, lightweight internal component that cycles beneath the fixed top rail. It contains the firing mechanism and operates in conjunction with the gas-delayed blowback system. Unlike traditional full-length slides, its low-mass design reduces reciprocating weight, delivering smoother recoil, quicker cycling, and greater shot-to-shot control.

name: Alien Optic Toprail
description: The Alien Optic-Ready Top Rail (Standard or Match) is a fixed, non-reciprocating module that mounts directly to the frame and barrel assembly. It supports RMS, RTS2, C-MORE RTS, and Trijicon RMRcc footprint optics via adapter plates, remaining completely independent of the slide’s movement. Because it is stationary and barrel-locked, the optic holds zero with absolute stability and never shifts under recoil.

name: Alien Retro Mount
description: The Retro Optic Mount is a universal optic plate designed for use with the Retro and Limited Optics upgrade kits. It attaches directly to the Retro slide, providing a stable platform for mounting red dot sights and enhancing target acquisition.

name: Alien Retro Toprail
description: The Alien Creator Retro Top Rail – Match converts the pistol to a slide-mounted optic setup while maintaining a trigger feel optimized for Limited Optics competition.

name: AR Carry Handle - Picatinny Rail
description: This Picatinny rail is designed to fit A1/A2 fixed or MIL-SPEC detachable AR-15/M4/M16 carry handles. Made from durable, black, anodized aluminum, it includes a thumb nut for quick, tool-free installation. The see-through channel allows for continued use of iron sights, even when optics are mounted.

name: AUG Modular Scope Mount
description: A Picatinny scope mount manufactured by Clawgear for Steyr AUG rifles equipped with the original 1.5x optical sight. It provides additional mounting space for compatible optics and accessories while retaining the integrated scope.

name: AUS O-ring - 34mm
description: The AUS Mount is a one-piece, 7075-T6 aluminum scope mount designed for 34mm optics. It attaches to Picatinny rails using a low-profile, spring-loaded steel clamp that can be tightened with either a hex or flathead screwdriver. It is finished with MIL-STD Type III hard anodizing.

name: AUS O-ring - 34mm (Serpent Guad)
description: The AUS Mount is a one-piece, 7075-T6 aluminum scope mount designed for 34mm optics. It attaches to Picatinny rails using a low-profile, spring-loaded steel clamp that can be tightened with either a hex or flathead screwdriver. It is finished with MIL-STD Type III hard anodizing.

name: B-13 Rail
description: The B-13 rail can be installed on a regular dovetail joint on the receiver of AK platform rifles. It allows for the installation of sights on the rifle and creates a Picatinny rail over the weapon's receiver.

name: Bayonet Lug Accessory Mount (BLAM2)
description: An accessory rail that clamps over a rifle’s bayonet lug to add a forward mounting point for lights, lasers, and other accessories.

name: BM-1 AKM Accessory Mount
description: This mount is designed for AKM-type barrels and allows for the attachment of lights, lasers, or other accessories. It's constructed of durable 6061-T6 aluminum with a black anodized finish and features two sturdy clamps for a secure fit.

name: FAMAS PGM Picatinny Rail
description: A Picatinny rail designed for the FAMAS upper handguard assembly. It provides a stable platform for compatible optics while retaining use of the original iron sights.

name: FAMAS Picatinny Grip Rail
description: A tri-rail mount for the FAMAS rifle, providing three Picatinny interfaces for attaching compatible foregrips, lasers, flashlights, and other accessories.

name: FAST FTC 30mm
description: A compact, flip-to-center magnifier mount that stows the optic below the sight plane for snag-free carrying and instant deployment. It features a force-to-overcome mechanism and can be mounted for left- or right-handed use. It fits most 30mm magnifiers with a 30mm ring interface.

name: FAST FTC 30mm (FDE)
description: A compact, flip-to-center magnifier mount that stows the optic below the sight plane for snag-free carrying and instant deployment. It features a force-to-overcome mechanism and can be mounted for left- or right-handed use. It fits most 30mm magnifiers with a 30mm ring interface.

name: FAST FTC OMNI
description: An advanced flip-to-center magnifier mount that positions the optic below the sight line when stowed, thereby eliminating side swing and the risk of snagging. It employs a force-to-overcome action.

name: FAST FTC OMNI (FDE)

name: G3 Extended Low-Profile Optic Mount
description: A low-profile extended Picatinny optic mount for G3 and HK91-pattern rifles. It provides ample mounting space for compatible optics while allowing continued use of the rifle's iron sights.

name: G3 Extended Low-Profile Optic Mount (Zero Hour)

name: G36 Iron Sight Rail

name: G36 Optic Rail

name: G36C Handguard Rails

name: Glock 17 L2 Cover Stripe
description: The Glock 17 L2 Cover Stripe serves as a practical accessory designed to cover the mounting area for collimators. Its purpose is to provide a clean and streamlined appearance while effectively concealing the unused mounting space on the firearm.

name: Glock 17 P40 Warhawk Cover Stripe
description: Inspired by World War II, this Glock 17 cover stripe features a captivating design that pays homage to the era. With a star at the top, it perfectly complements the overall P40 design theme. In addition, this striped cover effectively conceals the mounting area for collimators while maintaining the aesthetic integrity of the slide.

name: Glock 17 Rear Sight Acro Mount
description: The Aimpoint Glock ACRO Mount Plate allows for secure mounting of Aimpoint ACRO sights on Glock handguns.

name: Glock 17 Vortex Viper Adapter
description: The VORTEX VIPER Red Dot Mount adapter is a high-quality red dot mount plate for Glock pistols.

name: Glock Micro Mount
description: This mount is designed for Glock pistols and connects directly to the slide. It's designed specifically for first-generation Micro Series sights like the Micro T-1/H-1 to ensure a perfect fit.

name: Glock17 Holosun 507c Adapter
description: The Holosun 507c Adapter allows for secure attachment of the Holosun 507c red dot sight to Glock pistols. It is made of durable materials to ensure a stable mount, offering reliable performance for improved targeting.

name: High Sight Mount
description: A specialized mounting solution designed for Holosun optics. It allows for easy installation and secure attachment of the optic to various firearm platforms. The high-mount design raises the optic's position, providing a more comfortable and ergonomic shooting experience.

name: Holosun High Magnifier Mount
description: A raised mount for Holosun magnifiers. Its increased height aligns the magnifier with optics mounted at a higher sight line.

name: JULIET Flip-Away Mount (FDE)

name: L4 G24 Helmet NVG Mount

name: LEAP/03 Acro Mount

name: LEAP/03 Acro Mount (Ghost Nomad)

name: Light Mount V-Block and Rings

It is made from reinforced polymer and Mil-Spec anodized aluminum, and can accommodate lights with a body diameter of .75" to 1.04". Compatible with MOE Scout Mount, various M-LOK Cantilever and Offset Mounts, available in both aluminum and polymer.

name: Low Profile O-ring - 30mm
description: A compact and streamlined mounting option designed for attaching a 30mm diameter optic to a compatible firearm. With its low-profile design, it offers a closer alignment with the bore axis, resulting in improved cheek weld and target acquisition.

name: Low Profile O-ring - 34mm
description: These scope rings are made of highly durable anodized aluminum, which makes them lightweight and able to withstand harsher treatment. For versatility and ease of use, the mount is compatible with any 1913 or NATO rail.

With its low-profile design, the mount positions the optic closer to the bore axis, resulting in improved sight alignment and reduced sight-over-bore offset.

name: M-LOK Rail - 3 slot
description: Designed to be compatible with all M-LOK-equipped handguards and forearms, the 3-slot M-LOK aluminum rail sections allow for mounting a variety of 1913 Picatinny specification accessories, including lights, vertical grips, and more.

name: M-LOK Rail - 5 slot

Designed for use with all M-LOK compatible Hand Guards and Forends, this rail allows for easy attachment of various tactical accessories like grips and lights, providing enhanced customization options for your firearm.

name: M-LOK Rail - 7 slot

Designed for use with all M-LOK compatible Hand Guards and Forends, this rail allows for easy attachment of various tactical accessories like grips and lights, providing enhanced customization options for your firearm.

name: M-LOK Rail - 9 slot

name: M14/M1A Cluster Rail
description: The CASV-14 is an extended upper handguard rail system for the M1A/M14. It provides a stable platform for mounting optics and accessories while maintaining a low overall weight. Designed to fit standard-contour barrels and most GI-style stocks, it extends back to the stripper clip guide, creating a continuous top rail.

name: M1A 4th Generation Steel Scope Mount
description: A durable all-steel Weaver/Picatinny-style scope rail designed specifically for the M1A series.

name: M1A EBR Aluminium Scope Mount
description: This aluminum Picatinny rail is designed for Sage/EBR-style Enhanced Battle Rifle (EBR) stocks. Machined from a single solid piece, it’s lightweight and features a hard-coat anodized finish for durable, long-lasting use.

name: M1A EBR Aluminium Scope Mount (Black Hawk)
description: This aluminum Picatinny rail is designed for Sage/EBR-style Enhanced Battle Rifle (EBR) stocks. Machined from a single solid piece, it’s lightweight and features a hard-coat anodized finish for durable, long-lasting use.

name: M1A Scout Scope Mount
description: This sleek, low-profile Picatinny rail is made from durable 6061-T6 billet aluminum and is designed for the M1A Scout Squad and SOCOM-16 models.

name: M590 Picatinny Scope Rail

name: M590 Shockwave Quad Rail

name: M590 Shockwave Quad Rail (Raven Team)

name: M700 MOD*X Rail

name: M700 Picatinny Rail
description: These MIL-STD 1913 Picatinny Rails are lightweight and designed to mount directly onto the flattop receiver of short-action firearms.

name: M700 Picatinny Rail (Gray Company)
description: These MIL-STD 1913 Picatinny Rails are lightweight and designed to mount directly onto the flattop receiver of short-action firearms.

name: M870 Picatinny Quad Rail
description: Crafted from solid one-piece T6 6061 aluminum, the Black Aces Tactical Picatinny Quad Rail for Remington 870/1100 offers unmatched durability to withstand even the harshest conditions. This rail is designed to provide a secure and stable platform for mounting various accessories.

name: M870 Picatinny Rail
description: This 20" rail allows for mounting a variety of optics, including those commonly used on AR-15 rifles. This setup enables the use of iron sights typically found on AR-15 platforms. Additionally, the Picatinny rail provides flexibility for mounting optics with varying degrees of eye relief, accommodating individual preferences and shooting styles.

name: Magnifier FlipMount High
description: A quick-flip mount that allows for instant swinging of the magnifier in and out of the optical axis. It fits 39mm tubes and is optimized for the AR-15/M4.

name: Magnifier FlipMount Low
description: A quick-flip mount that swings the magnifier in or out of the optical path on demand. It is built for 30mm tubes and has a low baseline height of 38.5mm.

name: Micro Standard Mount
description: A dedicated mounting solution designed for the popular Aimpoint Micro series optics. It provides a secure attachment for the optic to various firearm platforms, ensuring reliable performance.

name: Mosin-Nagant Tri-Rail Scope Mount
description: The MNT-MNTR01 offers tactical versatility for the Mosin-Nagant, featuring an extended top rail to accommodate various rifle scope positions, allowing seamless adjustment of eye relief.

name: MP5 Ring Mount
description: This mount improves the functionality of the MP5SD silencer by adding three Picatinny rails that allow users to attach additional equipment, such as optics, lights, or grips, to customize their setup to meet specific needs and preferences.

name: MP5/G3 Low Profile Mount
description: Known for its low profile compared to other HK scope mounts, this mount is compatible with firearms ranging from .22 to .308 caliber, making it suitable for a wide range of different platforms. Its universal design allows it to be flipped in either direction without obstructing the ejection port, ensuring unparalleled flexibility during use.

name: MT-MB590 Optic Rail Mount
description: The UTG Mossberg 500/590 Scope Mount with Side Saddle Shell Holder and Picatinny Rail is made from a 6061-T6 matte black hard anodized aluminum construction. It is an ideal choice for quickly mounting optics and accessories on the 12-gauge Mossberg 500 and 590 tactical shotguns.

name: Rail Offset Adapter

name: Remington 788 Picatinny Rail
description: A one-piece Picatinny rail designed for the Remington 788. Precision-machined from lightweight aluminum, it provides a stable base for mounting optics. Its simple, durable design is essential for transforming the 788 into a reliable scoped hunting rifle.

name: Rhino Helmet NVG Mount
description: The Rhino mount, named for its distinctive shape when flipped up, allows the user to attach a night vision device to their helmet using a bayonet mount.

name: Rifleman 1" Detachable High Matte
description: A two-piece scope mount for 1″ main tubes. Machined from lightweight, anodized aluminum, it clamps with steel cross-bolt rings and fasteners for a secure hold without the weight of steel mounts.

name: SKS 101 Advanced Rail System
description: This Advanced Rail System is machined from a single block of high-quality 6061-T6 aircraft-grade aluminum for durability and reliability. Its Mil-Spec Type III hard black anodized finish enhances resistance to wear and tear. It also includes an integrated shell deflector to prevent malfunctions and protect optics from potential damage.

name: SKS Barrel Picatinny Mount
description: Constructed from durable aluminum alloy and steel with a matte black finish, this mount features a 1-inch Weaver rail with a single crosscut and clamps securely to the barrel with four hex screws.

name: SKS Rear Sight Picatinny Rail
description: This mount is compatible with all SKS variants and features a low-profile design and an integral rear sight notch that provides backup iron sight with the optic removed.

name: STS Mount
description: A tactical side-swing mount designed for rapid target transitions. It allows for an instant switch between magnified and unmagnified views while retaining zero. Precision-machined from aluminum, it can handle recoil and is compatible with G30, G33, G43, and G45 magnifiers. It is the standard mount for EOTECH optics.

name: Trijicon Low Picatinny Rail Mount
description: This compact adapter is constructed from 7075-T6 aluminum with a hardcoat anodized finish. It is designed specifically for attaching Trijicon RMR reflex sights to any MIL-STD-1913 Picatinny or Weaver rail.

name: Trijicon MRO Low Picatinny Rail Mount
description: The Trijicon AC32067 MRO Low Mount Adapter is a sleek, durable Picatinny/Weaver rail mount designed specifically for the Trijicon MRO reflex sight. It is made from high-quality aluminum with a hardcoat anodized finish.

name: UMP Tri-Rail
description: A three-piece Picatinny rail set for the UMP handguard. It provides additional mounting space for compatible foregrips, lights, lasers, and other accessories.

name: Vortex High Mount
description: The Vortex High Mount provides an elevated position for the optics, making it ideal for maintaining a natural shooting position and providing a clear line of sight over obstacles or when using iron sights. It's commonly used on rifles with flat-top receivers, ensuring compatibility with various scopes and red dots.

name: Vortex Low Mount
description: The Vortex Low Mount keeps optics closer to the barrel for a compact, streamlined setup. Ideal for shotguns, submachine guns, or applications where a lower sight height is preferred.

name: Vortex Spitfire Cover Stripe
description: This is a small protective mount cover for the Vortex Spitfire collimator mount. It protects the mount when no collimator is attached.

name: Vz. 61 Tactical Mount
description: This barrel mount is crafted for the Vz. 61 Skorpion and its civilian models. It includes dual Weaver/Picatinny rails and a threaded adapter for a flash suppressor, with an option for a sound suppressor. Designed for error-free installation, it's made of high-strength duralumin for a lasting performance.

name: Z17 Citadel Cover Stripe
description: The Glock 17 Zev Z17 Citadel Cover Stripe serves as a covering accessory designed to conceal the mounting area for collimators. It seamlessly complements the aesthetics of the Zev Z17 Citadel slide design.

name: Zenitco B-13N Rail
description: The Zenitco B-13N Rail is a durable rail system designed for mounting accessories on firearms. It attaches above the receiver and provides a stable platform for scopes, sights, and other attachments.
